moments.title: Black Friday & Cyber Monday Deals Continue
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially lands on Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday following on November 30, but many retailers have already launched sales and promotions across the UK.

angles.name: Deals are ON
angles.copy: Black Friday is officially Friday, but the deals are already in full swing! What's at the top of your shopping list this year?

angles.name: Cyber Monday Anticipation
angles.copy: Don't forget Cyber Monday is on the way too! If you're holding out for online-only tech deals, that's November 30th. Planning your strategy?

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! continues
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! is well underway from the Australian jungle, having launched on November 16th, with the final expected around December 6th.

angles.name: Jungle Drama
angles.copy: The jungle drama continues tonight! Who's your favourite to be crowned King or Queen of the jungle this year?

angles.name: Bushtucker Trials
angles.copy: Another night, another Bushtucker Trial! What's been the most gruesome challenge you've seen so far on I'm A Celeb?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing heads to Elstree
moments.blurb: Following Blackpool Week on November 21st, Strictly Come Dancing returns to Elstree Film Studios for its next live show on Saturday, November 28th, as the competition heats up towards the December 19th final.

angles.name: Post-Blackpool Buzz
angles.copy: After the glitz of Blackpool, Strictly is back at Elstree this Saturday! Who are you backing to make it to the semi-final?

angles.name: Judges' Favourite?
angles.copy: The judges are getting tough! Which couple needs to really bring their A-game this weekend to avoid the dance-off?

moments.title: UK Christmas Markets in Full Swing
moments.blurb: Christmas markets across the UK are now open, including major attractions in Manchester (until Dec 22), Birmingham (until Dec 24), and various London locations running into January.

angles.name: Market Magic
angles.copy: The scent of mulled wine and festive treats is in the air! UK Christmas Markets are officially open and bringing all the magic. Where's your favourite to visit?

angles.name: London Festive Fun
angles.copy: London's Christmas Markets are buzzing! From Winter Wonderland to Southbank Centre, what's your top pick for festive fun in the capital?

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Ahead
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns this weekend (November 28-29) with a full slate of fixtures, including a big clash between Arsenal and Manchester City on Sunday, November 29th.

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive Premier League weekend! Which match are you most looking forward to, and what are your score predictions?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Man City
angles.copy: Sunday sees a huge title clash as Arsenal host Manchester City! Who's taking the points in this crucial encounter?

moments.title: Jungle live at The O2 London
moments.blurb: British electronic music collective Jungle performs two nights at London's O2 Arena on November 24th and 25th, bringing their unique blend of funk, soul, and dance music to the stage.

angles.name: Jungle in London
angles.copy: Jungle are taking over The O2 tonight and tomorrow! Who's heading to Greenwich for some incredible funk and dance vibes?

angles.name: Busy Earnin'
angles.copy: Back on 74 or Busy Earnin' – what's your go-to Jungle track for a Tuesday night? They're live at The O2!

moments.title: Deep Purple play London
moments.blurb: Rock legends Deep Purple are performing at London's Eventim Apollo tonight, November 24th, and the Royal Albert Hall tomorrow, November 25th.

angles.name: Smoke on the Water
angles.copy: Deep Purple are bringing the rock to London tonight at the Eventim Apollo! Who's ready for a dose of classic rock legends?

angles.name: Rock Icons
angles.copy: Two nights of Deep Purple in London this week! Catch them tonight and tomorrow. What's your all-time favourite track?

moments.title: Justice land first UK Top 10 single
moments.blurb: French electronic duo Justice have achieved their first-ever UK Top 10 single with 'Flower In A Hurricane' (feat. Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard), climbing to number 9 on the Official UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Success
angles.copy: Massive news for Justice! They've just landed their first ever UK Top 10 single with 'Flower In A Hurricane'. Have you heard it?

angles.name: Dance Chart Climber
angles.copy: Justice breaking into the UK Top 10 with 'Flower In A Hurricane'! This track is a serious bop. What are your thoughts?

moments.title: Billy Idol turns 71
moments.blurb: British punk and rock icon Billy Idol celebrates his 71st birthday on Thursday, November 26th.

angles.name: Rebel Yell
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the one and only Billy Idol on Thursday! What's your favourite track from the punk rock legend?

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: From Generation X to a solo superstar, Billy Idol turns 71 this week! Celebrate with a blast of 'Rebel Yell' or 'White Wedding'.

moments.title: Britney Spears turns 45
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Britney Spears celebrates her 45th birthday on Tuesday, December 2nd.

angles.name: It's Britney, Bitch
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Britney Spears turns 45 on December 2nd. What's your all-time favourite Britney anthem?

angles.name: Pop Princess
angles.copy: Queen of Pop Britney Spears has a birthday next week! From 'Toxic' to 'Gimme More', which track gets you dancing?

moments.title: Ozzy Osbourne turns 78
moments.blurb: The Prince of Darkness, Ozzy Osbourne, celebrates his 78th birthday on Friday, December 3rd.

angles.name: Ozzy Ozzzzzyyy!
angles.copy: All hail the Prince of Darkness! Ozzy Osbourne turns 78 this Friday, December 3rd. What's your favourite Black Sabbath or solo track?

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Ozzy Osbourne's 78th birthday this week! A true rock icon. What's the wildest Ozzy story you've ever heard?

moments.title: Jay-Z celebrates 57th birthday
moments.blurb: Rap mogul and entrepreneur Jay-Z celebrates his 57th birthday on Saturday, December 4th.

angles.name: Hova's Birthday
angles.copy: Big birthday coming up for Jay-Z on December 4th! The rap legend turns 57. What's your favourite track from his incredible career?

angles.name: Empire State of Mind
angles.copy: From Marcy Projects to global icon, Jay-Z's influence is undeniable. Celebrate his 57th birthday this week with a classic track!

moments.title: Mariah Carey at The O2 London
moments.blurb: The Queen of Christmas, Mariah Carey, brings her festive show to London's O2 Arena on Monday, November 30th, just as her classic 'All I Want For Christmas Is You' re-enters the charts.

angles.name: All I Want for Christmas...
angles.copy: Mariah Carey is bringing Christmas to The O2 on Monday! Get ready for a festive spectacular. Who's going?

angles.name: Queen of Christmas
angles.copy: Her iconic hit is back in the charts, and Mariah Carey is live in London soon! It truly is beginning to look a lot like Christmas!

moments.title: Interpol & Bloc Party in Manchester
moments.blurb: Interpol and Bloc Party are co-headlining a show at Aviva Studios in Manchester tonight, November 24th, bringing their indie rock sounds to the city.

angles.name: Manchester Indie Night
angles.copy: Manchester! Interpol and Bloc Party are taking over Aviva Studios tonight! Who's excited for a huge night of indie rock?

angles.name: Indie Anthems
angles.copy: Two iconic bands, one stage! Interpol and Bloc Party are in Manchester tonight. What's your ultimate anthem from either band?
